items.title: Redemption demand falling in Q3 as 'noise' dissipates – Blackstone
items.summary: Blackstone Inc. (NYSE: BX) told investors this morning that it has seen signs of decreasing redemption demand in its flagship non-traded BDC, which CEO Jon Gray attributed to a diminishing “level of noise” by the media. Blackstone’s non-investment-grade private credit strategies posted a gross return of 1% in Q2, and a trailing twelve-month gross return of 7%.
